Patient says, 'it started with vomiting, so I vomited a couple of times.'
Patient states, 'the vomiting has now stopped. Is that right? You said' / Patient: 'Yes, yes.' indicating resolution.
Doctor asks, 'have you noticed any other symptoms, like tummy pain?' Patient replies, 'Uh, not, not really, no.'
Patient reports, 'I feel like, um, I can't, really drink too much, so I feel very dehydrated.' and reiterates feeling dehydrated after drinking.
When asked about solids, patient says, 'Uh, not much, not much. So just a little bit,' indicating poor oral intake.

Doctor advises, 'you can drink plenty of fluids. Really try and flush the toxins out of your body.'
Doctor: 'You can get things from the pharmacy, which is called Dioralyte... it's a type of fluid replacement drink.'
Doctor advises, 'you can take some Paracetamol if you're feeling feverish and weak.'
Doctor recommends time off work and symptomatic management, which implies rest, though 'rest' word is not explicit; however, 'continue taking time off work' effectively directs rest.

The doctor recommends 'drink plenty of fluids' and Dioralyte but does not specifically mention 'frequent small sips' in the transcript.
Doctor states, 'Let's see how the next few days go. And if you're still not better next week, I want you to come back and see me.'
